page: Amazon Web Services r5d.12xlarge is a memory-optimized instance featuring 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8259CL processor running at 3.1 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. The instance includes 1800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and operates on the Nitro hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the r5d.12xlarge delivers average multi-core CPU performance, as seen in its multi-threaded stress-ng and Geekbench scores. However, single-core performance is relatively weak, falling into the bottom 25% for single-threaded tasks like gzip compression. Memory bandwidth remains in the average tier, with read-only large block speeds of 108.09 GB/sec and write speeds of 47.91 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET operations also perform within the average range.

Given its high memory capacity and integrated 1800 GB NVMe SSD local storage, this instance offers a balanced resource density for memory-intensive workloads requiring fast local scratch space. It is well-suited for hosting relational databases, in-memory caches, and data processing pipelines that benefit from high RAM capacity and local NVMe storage, though it is less optimal for single-thread-bound compute tasks.
